## New: Even Train Distribution - Empty train stations adjust their priority to ensure that trains are evenly disbtributed between all stations. The required signal is a pulse on the green wire, due to this the base grid (and the stations) need to be updated.

### This is a RailBlock system for Space Age. It is designed around easy scalability from early to late game and low buffers. It is still work in progress and currently features early to mid game modules for all planets.

It is designed around 1-2 Trains. Small modules have a periodicity of 76 tiles. To keep buffers low, train stations are designed without buffer chests. Empty train stations lead to partially full trains to be dispatched (no more waiting for full trains of blue chips in the early game). Train stations each have one waiting spot. With 2 trains for each input station and 1 train for each output station, trains hop from gap to gap. Please mind: In the early game you might need to manually send freshly built trains to input stations, because not all trains can go to output stations at first.

For __Nauvis__ it can be used early on, from red/green science. There are different tiers of modules for differnt stages of the game. For the hub module a mod can be used, that allows to use the rate calculator for the whole base (https://mods.factorio.com/mod/RailBlockHubRateCalcRecipes). On Nauvis I expand using artillery once Vulcanus can supply enough raw material. For that, a module that produces walls, laser turrents, etc. at matching quantities is included. The current size of the base is set on the constant combinator (expecting a square base with x double modules on each side). It will then produce enough to allow you to expand in all direction for 2 modules, so the new base size is square with x+4 modules on each side.

For __Vulcanus__ most of the default modules can be used, once you have cliff explosives. Some Vulcanus specific modules are also included (coal liquefaction, power from sulfuric Acid). Check my other blueprints for my pre cliff explosive Vulcanus blueprints.

For __Fulgora__ without foundation the elevated rail blueprints can be used to connect mining and production outposts. Scrap trains are designed as bidirectional 1-1-1 trains with specific interfaces to the default one directional rail blueprints. Scrap-Mining is designed for 1 train for each station (no waiting spot) with direct Train mining. Typically 3 stations should fit on small scrap islands. Input stations are designed with AB unloading: 2 bays are unloaded on after the other. Check my other blueprints for my production outposts.

For __Fulgora__ with foundation a module to sort recycled materials into trains is included. This allows to use all other modules. Fulgora specific science module is also included.

__Gleba__ is also solved by trains, but fruit trains are designed a little differently: trains wait at buffer stations. If a module requires fruits, a train is dispatched to an output station. Only if a train is at an output station the agri Towers harvest the fruit (connect a green wire from the station to the agri tower, for signal T). This improves freshness. Mind that only 80 trees fit into one 1-2 Train. Output stations only allow one train every 5 minutes to allow for fruits to grow. This means that there is only 1 tain for each output station and no additional trains for input stations. Some Gleba specific modules are included (rocket fuel, power, sulfuric acid). At the beginning, blueprints from the design book can be use to spaghetti connect a starter base. Once you have enough artifical and overgrowth soil, farming can also be put into the periodic blocks.

For __Aquilo__ a starter base, heated base blocks and some first specific production blocks (ice platform, lithium plate, ...) are included. Train stations are designed so that they should work without a heated grid. But you should have enough rocket fuel to just heat everything...

It uses:
- https://factorioprints.com/view/-OBl_0jTgBW6EQ8uDWTv
- smelters and T5 Demo module based on: https://www.youtube.com/@Zeroster_Guides
- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lks47fY0xF0
- https://factoriobin.com/post/vs2pqt

- v2.3 (Apr 25): T0-T1 with partial dispatching. This reduces negative buffer effects.
- v2.4,2.5: Bugfix
- v2.6: Changes to dispatching method, bugfixes and Improvements (e. g. module block). T2 modules added.
- v2.10 (May 25): T3 Blocks added. Beta test of first few T4 Vulcanos Blocks.
- v2.11 Works well on Vulcanos as well
- v2.12 Elevated Rails, T4 (Fulgora) Blocks, some Fulgora specifics.
- v2.13 Improvements to elevated rails and quality grinders. First Beta for Gleba by trains.
- v2.14 Bugfixes
- v2.16 (June 25) Gleba by Trains beta 2
- v2.17 (Jul 25) Aquilo by Trains beta 1. Fulgora with Foundation beta 1 (scrap to sorted trains, allows to use default modules). Minor changes to Hub.
- v2.18 Aquilo modules, new gleba farming modules.
- v2.19 (Aug 25): Refinements, bug fixes, improvements. Train loaded rocket silos. Fluoroketone build.
- v2.20: accumulator prodcution in science module
- v3: even train distribution
